parameters.name: stringSearch
parameters.description: String to be searched in the following fields: code, name, nif, phone, phone2, email, email2, website

parameters.name: has_no_products_yet
parameters.description: If true, only projects with no other products will be returned (as determined by the has_no_products_yet column)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Project type. It can be an integer, a string or an array containing multiple Type codes.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User ID. It can be an integer, a string or an array containing multiple User IDs.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Device ID. It can be an integer, a string or an array containing multiple Device IDs.

parameters.name: correctProjects
parameters.description: If true, only projects with all the needed information for sending the contract through VidSigner will be returned.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Milestone ID to be included in the search. It can be an integer, a string or an array containing multiple Milestone IDs.

parameters.name: withoutStatus
parameters.description: Milestone ID to be excluded from the search. It can be an integer, a string or an array containing multiple Milestone IDs.

parameters.name: show_all
parameters.description: If true, all the results will be returned in a single page
